title: Figma Plugin Phase 8 - Test File Assertion Hardening
overview: Eliminate fragile hardcoded numeric assertions in test files by replacing them with shared constants (FONT_SIZE, FALLBACK_VALUES, etc.) to prevent drift when design values change.

context.problem: 37 test assertions use hardcoded numeric values like .toBe(16), .toBe(600), .toBe(12) instead of shared constants. When design values change, these tests could pass incorrectly or require manual updates.
context.current_state: Phase 7 is COMPLETE - all generators read from registry.styling. Drift detection tests warn about 37 fragile assertions but don't enforce. Tests technically pass but are drift-prone.
context.why_now: Phase 7 (registry integration) is COMPLETE. This phase addresses test quality to ensure the full code-to-Figma sync pipeline is robust.
files_with_fragile_assertions: Other files with similar patterns (22+ warnings)

primary: Replace hardcoded numeric assertions with shared constants
Ensure all test files import and use FONT_SIZE, FALLBACK_VALUES from shared.ts
Convert drift detection warning to enforcing test
metrics: All drift detection tests passing and enforcing

decision_tree.description: When to replace vs keep hardcoded values
rules: If value exists in FONT_SIZE, FALLBACK_VALUES, SPACING, OPACITY -> replace
If value is component-specific (e.g., 30 for text-3xl) -> keep or add comment
If value comes from registry.styling -> use registry comparison instead
